logo_override.validation_detail: same-origin fetch from www.unhcr.org returned HTTP 200 with content-type image/svg+xml, 17725 bytes; single CSS class .c { fill: #0072bc } i.e. UNHCR blue on a transparent ground (no white strokes), viewBox 0 0 460 100 full wordmark

notes: The shard host is not the awarding body's domain: unhcr-dafi-tertiary.scholarshipsplatform.com is a third-party 'DAFI Programme Management Platform' run by Good Grants / Creative Force (page footer reads 'Copyright (c) Creative Force Ltd', markup carries twitter:site @awardforce and datadome on ajaxListenerPath). Its only artwork is og:image https://af4-frankfurt-production.imgix.net/files/O/v/w/E/5/u/kGClV6xniZ/file.png and the account logo rendered by <account-logo> from the same imgix CDN - both are a CDN mirroring the file, so rejected under rules 1 and 6; the imgix favicon likewise. The awarding body is UNHCR (the stored official_source names UNHCR as the operator, funded by Germany/Denmark/Czechia), so I went to UNHCR's own domain. Direct ctx.request.get probes of unhcr.org assets were refused (403 HTML / timeout), so I fetched them same-origin from inside a loaded www.unhcr.org page, which the WAF allows. Probed: /themes/custom/project/logo.svg = 200, image/svg+xml, 17725 B, fill #0072bc -> ACCEPTED; /themes/custom/project/images/logo/EN-UNHCR-White.svg = 200 but fill:#fff -> rejected under rule 3 (white-on-transparent); /themes/custom/project/logo-print.png = 200, image/png, 175x43, canvas analysis mean luminance 93, 0% light pixels, sample opaque RGB 2,117,184 (UNHCR teal-blue) -> also acceptable but the vector wordmark was preferred. host_evidence is same_registrable_domain relative to the awarding body (unhcr.org); note explicitly that this is NOT the shard host, because the shard host is a third-party platform and no acceptable asset is served from it.
